title: DIAL SDLC Stage Message
description: Sticky JSON payload every SDLC stage writes (via Claude --json-schema). Envelope fields (contract_version, agent_version, run_id, trigger) are injected by the renderer — agents do not write them. Top-level is intentionally open (additionalProperties: true). Agent-specific structured data goes under `payload`. The renderer recognizes two payload conventions: `findings[]` (reviewer-shaped issues, rendered as a table) and `comment_markdown` (verbatim body that replaces the default rendering).

contract_version.description: Schema contract version. Injected by the renderer.

agent_version.description: Agent version (semver). Injected by the renderer from the workflow's agent_version input.

run_id.description: Correlation ID — the GitHub Actions run ID. Injected by the renderer.

trigger.description: Event context that fired this run. Injected by the renderer.

stage.description: Stage identifier; pinned by the composite action to the workflow's stage_name.

summary.description: One short human-readable line for the sticky PR comment.

payload.description: Agent-specific structured data. Open shape: any keys allowed. The renderer recognizes two well-known sub-conventions.

findings.description: Reviewer convention. Each entry is one issue. Review agents should include repo-relative file and head-side line for line-specific findings; the platform can publish those as inline PR review comments and render the rest in the sticky summary.

inline_comment.description: Platform annotation added after the agent writes stage-output.json; agents should not set this.

comment_markdown.description: Override convention. If set, replaces the renderer's default body (findings table) with this markdown verbatim. Use for non-reviewer agents (test-gen, benchmark, migration, doc-gen).
